description: Liqlip windows: the shelf, the HUD, the settings window and the screenshot windows (capture overlay, QAO stack, editor, pinned pictures). Geometry and visibility are driven from Rust; the pages only invoke the app's own commands and listen to events (core:default — it also covers the shelf's isVisible). No page calls a plugin (autostart, dialog, opener run from Rust). Window calls a page does make are granted to that window only: settings.json, screenshot.json (W8-A).
